source: PC NFH2, the anger gauge's jumps in Badinfos' 100 % run (tools/pcref/amounts.py: the jump per second scaled to the full bar, 92 % of the crop, labelled with the HUD bubble's activity) — a jump that hits the full bar is a lower bound and keeps the mobile value where that is higher; a jump shared by linked coins is split in the mobile proportions; an unmeasured coin keeps the mobile value. E11 Neighbour Over Board: +19 the rod (97 s), +25 the boat (123), +38 between the boat and the jacket — the cabin phone with Olga's child, split 11 + 27 (146), +25 the jacket (163), +25 the diving gear (175), +16 the sweets at the full bar (206). PC data (ship3/tricks.xml, rage per trick in thousandths of the gauge): the mobile AngerAmount values are the PC's for every trick this level pays — no overlay. The gauge jumps read off Badinfos' video (2026-09-08) ran 10-25 %% high and are withdrawn.  PC leveldata.xml: ship3 needs mincoins 5 of its 8 where the mobile's WinningTricksCount is 6 — the only Season 2 level whose pass count differs (the other thirteen equal the PC's). The gauge is 100 000 rage long — the mobile's AngryMeterMaximum 100: the PC dialog (nfh2 dialogs/*/menuleft_bar.xml) gives the rageometer range 0..100000 and GameLogic.dll flags 100000 (docs/PC_ROUTINES.md); the 80 read off the video was the bar's geometry, as the Season 1 tube's was. Its decay is the mobile's 0.37 %/s: the bar falls 41 -> 11 % over 70 trick-free seconds of E01 (tools/pcref/gauge.py, x0.8 for the crop). The decay is leveldata.xml's time="30" per 1/12 s tick (GameLogic.dll fcn.10044234: rage -= the level record's +0x28, the app's leveldata parser stores `time` there; the HUD clock divides the tick count by 12) — PCRageDecay 30, 0.36 %/s against the mobile's 0.37. Compound against ship3/objects.xml on 2026-09-17: the cabin phone's `crash` credits phone_normal 10 and phone_loud 20 (the mobile CabinPhone 10 + its linked OlgaChild 25) — OlgaChild 20; the toilet's wcright 20 is the ladder's own 20.
